name: Loyal Protector
summary: When an ally within 5 ft is targeted by an attack, and you can see the attacker, you may use your reaction before the attack roll is resolved to impose disadvantage on that roll. If the attack still hits, you may choose to take half of the damage dealt to the ally; that transferred damage cannot be reduced again by Loyal Protector.
